definitions.explanation: To become old in years. A slightly literary word; in conversation people say {年|とし}を{取|と}る. Most often seen in the forms {年老|としお}いた (old, aged) and {年老|としお}いて.

examples.japanese: {年老|としお}いた⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧。
{年老|としお}いて⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: Even in old age, he keeps working energetically.

examples.japanese: {年老|としお}いた⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: She went back to her hometown to look after her aged mother.

notes:
An ichidan, intransitive verb. Before a noun, {年老|としお}いた means "elderly" and sounds gentler than ⟦{老|お}いた→老いる：04582_oiru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年老|としお}いた⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧: one's aged parents
- {年老|としお}いた⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧: an old dog
- {年老|としお}いて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: after growing old

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get older — the everyday expression
- ⟦{老|お}いる→老いる：04582_oiru⟧: to grow old — more literary still
- ⟦{老|ふ}ける→老ける：16742_fukeru⟧: to look old, to age in appearance — about how one looks, not one's years
